llm.seed_rule: payload = f'task2_v1|{case_id}|{component}|{run}|{sample_index}'; seed = int.from_bytes(sha256(payload)[:4], 'big') & 0x7fffffff; component in {explain, localize, localize_clarified}

confidence_rule.definition: high iff >= min_agree samples share the same (target ID, modification type), the target exists, >= min_non_ambiguous valid samples are not ambiguous, and invalid samples <= max_invalid; otherwise low (clarifying question only, no critique). Invalid = not JSON, fails the sample schema, or (object, aspect) does not map to an existing target ID.
confidence_rule.majority_target: most frequent target among valid samples; ties broken by sample order

neighbourhood_rule.L0: query customers may change vehicle; all others fixed to their vehicle; both routes re-sequenced
neighbourhood_rule.L1: plus each query customer's 2 nearest customers (distance, ties by index)
neighbourhood_rule.escalation: only when the current level is infeasible; infeasible reported only after L2
neighbourhood_rule.anchor: smallest customer not involved in the query stays on its vehicle (customer 1 if all are involved); same anchor for local and full methods
neighbourhood_rule.modification_queries: involved customers = customers on the routes of the modified indicators

attribution_rule.infeasible: attribution set = business-specific constraints (cap[k]) of the Gurobi IIS
attribution_rule.feasible: attribution set = undirected edges e[i,j] that differ between the current solution and the optimum with the decision forbidden
attribution_rule.lp: LP-relaxation duals / reduced costs are reported for reference only

latency.local_with_model_setup: apply query constraints + warm start + all levels solved + undo (resident model built once at start-up, reported separately)
latency.full_with_model_setup: fresh model build + solve, no warm start
latency.statistics: median, mean, p95 (nearest rank) over all repeats

metrics.attribution: inclusion = returned set contains every GT element; precision/recall per case (macro) and pooled (micro), overall and for the constraint and variable parts; GT set with the best F1 when several are acceptable
metrics.explanation: pass = LLM text passes the number and entity checks within 2 attempts
metrics.counterfactual: local vs full: feasibility agreement over all queries; objective within 1% and identical change set over queries where both are feasible; each method also against the exhaustive ground truth; the reversal flag is reported but not compared
metrics.localization: correct = majority target in the GT target list; overall, among predicted high, among predicted low; clarification rate; invalid-sample rate; expected vs predicted confidence; re-localization with the simulated clarification answer (generic question when the first pass was high)
metrics.runs: LLM parts 3 independent runs, mean and sample std; deterministic parts once

supplementary_queries: all MOVE (8) and FIX_ARC (2 x 8 x 7 = 112) queries on the reference optimum
